Selected Work

Selected work in data science, statistical modeling, behavioral data analysis, and reproducible quantitative workflows.

Segmentation · Behavioral response

Modeling Differences in Workplace Solidarity

Five-study project identifying how support, competition, and representation shape group-level differences in responses to workplace equality initiatives.

Policy change · Credibility modeling

Modeling Responses to DEI Policy Change

Public survey and experimental data used to analyze how symbolic versus substantive DEI action and policy reversals affect perceived credibility.

Mixed-effects modeling · Group dynamics

Analyzing Asymmetric Belief Change in Groups

Behavioral data from online group conversations modeled to understand how audience composition shaped belief change and action-readiness.

Longitudinal analysis · Repeated measures

Modeling Daily Variation with Experience Sampling

A repeated-measures data project using multilevel methods to distinguish within-person and between-person patterns over time.
